arms.COMOVING: GATE_MASK = COMOVING: the downstream half of the CURRENT track, re-centred each event. Tests MASK REGISTRATION.
arms.MULTISITE: SPREAD = MULTISITE on the parent frozen mask: the quota is spread proportionally over every eligible cell instead of draining them in order. Tests whether the limit is per-site depth or total capacity.
arms.PARENT: reused verbatim from 07A PARENT_Q400_UNIFORM -- no new engine call
arms.SHAM: reused verbatim from 07A (identical code hash, identical t256 state) -- no new engine call
arms.SRC_DISPERSED: parent sink, source spread proportionally over the whole track EXCEPT the sink mask. Mass-matched control: does the coupling gain need upstream locality, or is generic replenishment enough?
arms.SRC_SINKSIDE: parent sink, source deposited into the sink's own cells. Futile-cycle bound of the locality ladder.
arms.TRACKALL: GATE_MASK = TRACKALL: the whole current track. Upper bound on reachability.
arms.UNTRACKED: GATE_TRACK = false on the parent frozen mask, GATE_THRESH = true: the sink may take matter that has detached from the tracked component. Tests whether the track gate itself is the limiter.

co_primary_safety_endpoint.definition: number of the nine blocks whose tracked component is continuous and intact at the horizon
co_primary_safety_endpoint.name: ITT_TRACK_CONTINUITY
co_primary_safety_endpoint.rule: an arm counts as an improvement ONLY IF it raises DELIVERED_FRACTION (paired sign test p < 0.05) AND its ITT continuity is not lower than PARENT's. An arm that increases throughput by destroying the component is recorded as a throughput result and explicitly NOT as a regime improvement.

decision_rule_frozen_before_any_07A_resu.definition_R: R = fraction of REJECTED events at which CAP_TRACKALL > 0 while CAP_PARENT = 0, i.e. removable matter exists inside the tracked component but the frozen actuator cannot reach it
decision_rule_frozen_before_any_07A_resu.if_R_at_least_0.5: the limiter is MASK REGISTRATION, an actuator property. The primary contrast is COMOVING vs PARENT.
decision_rule_frozen_before_any_07A_resu.if_R_below_0.5: the limiter is MATERIAL DEPLETION inside the reachable region. The primary contrast is SRC_DISPERSED vs PARENT, because the question becomes how fast matter is resupplied where the actuator can act.
decision_rule_frozen_before_any_07A_resu.purpose: the rule fixes which single contrast carries the confirmatory claim in 07C; it does not select which arms are run

primary_endpoint.analysis: median per arm per size over the NINE blocks (intention to treat, blocks that lose the track keep the realized mass they achieved and are never dropped); paired exact sign test against PARENT, block by block
primary_endpoint.definition: realized_sink summed over the forced phase, divided by planned_sink (320 * quantum), one value per block
primary_endpoint.name: DELIVERED_FRACTION
primary_endpoint.why: it is the delivered dose, not the planned dose. FLUX_06 showed that multiplying the planned dose by 8 multiplies the delivered removal by only 2.3-3.0.

prohibitions_carried_forward: internal events are never independent replicates
the nine blocks stay in every ITT analysis including after track loss
survivors are never presented as the complete cohort
no residue is called a scaffold without a functional intervention
no physical crossing is attributed from a moving tracker alone
no life / identity / autonomy / metabolism / organisation claim is fabricated
a throughput gain obtained by destroying the component is never reported as an improvement
secondary_endpoints: event rejection rate and the complete cause taxonomy
terminal mass_in_frozen_C256 / M256 (fixed frame, immune to tracker motion)
median eligible sites per event and median capacity per event

shared_design.dose: Q400 uniform: 320 events, quantum M256/80, spacing 16, first 272, last 5376, coast 2048, horizon 7424
shared_design.independent_unit: one block = one (size, seed) lineage. Internal events are NEVER replicates.
shared_design.order: SINK_FIRST in every arm, the parent's order, because fixture 6 showed the overlapping placement SINKSIDE is order-dependent by construction
shared_design.t256_states: the very checkpoints written by 07A, verified by SHA-256 before use

why_this_design: 07A measures WHERE the sink's capacity goes without perturbing it. 07B intervenes on each candidate limiter, one gate at a time, at matched dose, matched quantum, matched schedule and matched t256 state. Every arm is conservative, provenance-blind and atomic; the arms differ ONLY in the eligibility rule or in where the source deposits.
